email.question: A customer received a damaged shipment. Write a professional apology email offering a free replacement within 24 hours.
email.correctAnswer: Dear Customer, I am extremely sorry to hear that you received a damaged shipment. We apologize for the inconvenience caused. We are offering you a free replacement product which will be dispatched within 24 hours. Thank you for your patience and understanding. Best regards, Customer Support Team.

typing: Non-voice email support requires high attention to grammar, tone, and resolution speed. Accuracy builds customer trust. Professionalism in written communication is crucial for business operations.

storyG.question: Tell me about your Happiest Moment (Getting your first job offer).
storyG.correctAnswer: I woke up early and got ready for my interview. I reached the office on time. I greeted the interviewer with a smile. I answered all the interview questions confidently. I completed all the interview rounds successfully. I went back home and waited for the result. I received a phone call from the HR team. They offered me my first job. I thanked the HR for giving me this opportunity. I immediately shared the good news with my family. My parents congratulated me and felt proud. We celebrated the special day together. We ordered my favorite food. We clicked many happy pictures. My friends also congratulated me. I thanked God for this wonderful opportunity. I promised myself to work hard. I became more confident about my future. That day became a beautiful memory. It was the happiest moment of my life. Thank you for giving me this opportunity!
